name: Very Merrytime Warm Holiday Loaf Bread Service with Truffle Butter Dip
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder, Magic & Treasure · Very Merrytime ("Happy Holidays" Menu)
whyItWorks: Soft, pillowy pull-apart white holiday bread served warm in the basket; very gentle on the gut when paired with a light smear of butter.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Pull from the soft white interior of the holiday loaf and use a light touch of truffle butter (or ask for plain butter/olive oil).
watchOuts: Truffle butter is rich in dairy fat; use sparingly
